anchors.description: Outer bezel width of the left-desk dark LCD monitor: 3D straight-line distance between its visible top-left and top-right screen corners.
anchors.visible_evidence: Large flat black rectangular screen standing on the left desk, all four bezel corners of the top edge clearly visible against the light wall; width-to-height ratio ~1.6 consistent with a widescreen desktop monitor.
anchors.identity_uncertainty: Exact panel size unknown; could be a 21.5-27 inch PC monitor (bezel width 0.47-0.62 m) or a small TV. Interval covers the common office sizes.

anchors.description: Vertical drawer pitch of the centre steel filing cabinet: 3D distance between the two visible horizontal drawer-gap seams on its front face.
anchors.visible_evidence: Light-grey steel cabinet with three stacked drawer faces, each with a recessed label holder and a bar pull; two horizontal drawer-gap shadow lines are plainly visible across the front face at the two chosen heights.
anchors.identity_uncertainty: Letter- vs legal-size and 2- vs 3-drawer variants differ; standard drawer front heights are 0.28-0.32 m, 2-drawer units can reach ~0.35 m.

anchors.description: Width of the white desktop laser printer on the right desk: 3D straight-line distance between its front-left and front-right vertical corners.
anchors.visible_evidence: White boxy printer sitting on the wooden desk, dark output slot on top and a paper/name label on the front; front face bright and roughly rectangular, right corner adjacent to a stack of white papers.
anchors.identity_uncertainty: Specific model unknown (could be HP/Canon/Brother-class compact laser, 0.35-0.40 m wide); right corner partly close to overexposed papers, so a wide interval is used.

anchors.description: Front-face height of the desktop PC tower standing on the floor at the right: 3D distance between its top front edge and its bottom front edge.
anchors.visible_evidence: Silver/black tower with dark external drive-bay block on top and horizontal ventilation slats at the bottom, standing on the wooden floor next to the bookshelf; silver top edge and floor contact edge both visible.
anchors.identity_uncertainty: Could be mini-tower or full/mid-tower case (0.35-0.52 m tall) and its top carries a small dark object, so the upper edge is taken at the case top, not the object.

anchors.description: Front-face width of the centre steel filing cabinet: 3D distance between its left and right front vertical edges at mid-drawer height.
anchors.visible_evidence: Bright front face of the steel cabinet bounded by a clear brightness step to the darker left storage cabinet and to the dark space at its right; both vertical edges run the full drawer height.
anchors.identity_uncertainty: 15-inch (0.38 m) letter and 18-inch (0.46 m) lateral widths both plausible; the front face is seen at an oblique angle, so the projected width is foreshortened.
